subsystem.non_database_inputs: Discovery slices, registered policy/budget, data cache, candidates and opt-in Research Bank sources
subsystem.non_database_outputs: Quantitative job receipts, ledger evidence, candidates and refused/approved gate classifications
subsystem.initialization_path: Kernel research thread -> lazy ResearchRunner -> isolated child; separate CLI/bridge/external workers
subsystem.entry_point_note: Anchor is the primary module contract; concrete invocable functions are in source_entry_functions. Library modules have no independent scheduler.

initialization_and_schedule.detail: Configured research thread schedules bounded isolated jobs and yields to slow trading cycles.
Quantitative evaluator receives point-in-time WorldModel context.
Opt-in predictive bridge consumes retained Research Bank evidence into isolated numerical jobs.

interfaces.detail: Configured research thread schedules bounded isolated jobs and yields to slow trading cycles.

Opt-in predictive bridge consumes retained Research Bank evidence into isolated numerical jobs.

module_responsibilities.summary: The research pipeline: discover, explain, prove, repeat.
Look at the search from outside the kernel.
One searched rule: a set of AND-ed parts, both directions, one geometry.
The known-good rule, confined to the same window as the challengers.
Receipts for one joint timing hypothesis; no independence fallback.
Score one combination on the discovery slice.
Opt-in question-driven external evidence worker, independent of Kernel.
The error budget: LORD++ online false-discovery control, plus the brake.
Read-only adapter for questions committed by the existing shadow producer.
Does this part earn its place?
What the child process does, and nothing else.
Every combination the search ever looked at, kept or not.
What to evaluate next.
Does the whole book of entries beat itself fired at one random offset?
Normal opt-in asynchronous Research Bank consumer, independent of Kernel.
Exact translation into existing planner/runner jobs and registered policy.
Content-bound RES-08 receipts around the registered quantitative machinery.
The referee — held-out gates for the search's discovery survivors.
One step of the search: plan, run a child, write, decide.
Where the search is allowed to look.
The thesis contract: what a proposed explanation of a survivor must say,
Measure every gauge on the discovery slice: where its percentiles sit,
The two universes the search is scored on, and how deep the store is.
What a searched condition may say.
